basic_info.description:
Step into elegance at 4243 Folsom Street, a modern sanctuary nestled in the vibrant Bernal Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. This refined residence offers three spacious bedrooms and two pristine bathrooms, enveloped within 1,539 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. The heart of the home is the open kitchen and dining area, showcasing brand new high-end appliances, a full pantry wall, and an island with an oversized sink, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Skylight, recessed lighting and artist light fixtures throughout enhance the ambiance, illuminating luxurious new flooring. All new windows, roofing, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and sidings at the front and back of the building ensure peace of mind and comfort.

The low maintenance backyard, complete with an irrigated system for planters, offers a serene outdoor retreat. A rare find in the city, the attached garage accommodates two cars side-by-side, providing both convenience and ample storage. With easy access to freeways, this home is a stone's throw from lively city amenities, offering a perfect balance of tranquility and urban vibrance. Seize this opportunity to own a piece of modern elegance in a coveted location.
